name: linux_19_shutdown_during_catalogue_work
comment: Linux release qualification for the CatalogVaultClient teardown race found during 1.1.6 qualification. Run from an empty tagged AppData root with no reachable local data/*.db so catalogVaultState.fetching becomes true from the real Colosseum-Data release fetch. Quit WHILE work is still active through Main.qml global.quit (Ctrl+Q -> Qt.quit). Suite-level acceptance must require exitCode==0, crashed==false, no surviving child process, and a clean same-profile relaunch; any partial .downloading residue must either be absent or recover honestly on that relaunch. Never replace this with SIGTERM/kill because the product teardown path is the subject under test.

steps.label: session owns a disposable tagged data root
catalogue vault has entered real background fetch
prove shutdown happens before catalogue work finishes
capture the live pre-quit background-work state
